vocabulary.meaning_en: the way you feel at a particular time
vocabulary.example: She's in a good mood today.
His behaviour at work was excellent.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very pale because you are scared
vocabulary.example: He went as white as a sheet when he heard the noise.
Don't be a yellow belly; help your friend!

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who is not brave
vocabulary.example: Only a coward runs away from a friend in trouble.
The manager was red in the face with anger.
She turned red when everyone looked at her.

vocabulary.meaning_en: feeling shy or ashamed in front of others
vocabulary.example: I was embarrassed when I fell on the stairs.

vocabulary.note_en: tickle = make someone laugh by touching them
vocabulary.example: Peter was tickled pink about his promotion.
Grandpa is 80 and still in the pink.
Greg was green with envy when he saw Josh's new car.

vocabulary.meaning_en: wanting something similar to what another person has
wanting the exact thing that another person has
vocabulary.example: He was jealous of his brother's success.
Don't let the green-eyed monster control you.
I'm feeling a bit blue today.

vocabulary.word: talk until you're blue in the face
vocabulary.meaning_en: talk for a long time with no result
vocabulary.meaning_ar: يتكلّم حتى ينقطع نفَسه دون فائدة
vocabulary.example: You can talk until you're blue in the face; he won't change his mind.
Mr. E is still green at his new job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: using the same first sound in several words, e.g. Peter, pink
vocabulary.note_en: A trick to help you remember.

fine_lines.title: red in the face vs turn red
fine_lines.explanation_ar: red in the face تعني غاضبًا جدًا. turn red تعني محرجًا وخجلًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Red in the face = very angry. Turn red = embarrassed.

examples.sentence: He shouted until he was red in the face.
She turned red when the teacher praised her.

fine_lines.title: red in the face vs blue in the face
fine_lines.explanation_ar: red in the face غضب. blue in the face تعب من كثرة الكلام دون نتيجة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Red in the face = anger. Blue in the face = exhausted from talking with no result.

examples.sentence: Dad was red in the face when he saw the broken window.
I explained it until I was blue in the face.

fine_lines.title: envy vs jealousy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: envy أن تريد شيئًا مثل ما عند غيرك. jealous أن تريد الشيء نفسه الذي يملكه غيرك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Envy: you want something like what another person has. Jealous: you want the exact thing they have.

examples.sentence: I envy your job; I want a good job too.
He's jealous; he wants your house, not one like it.

fine_lines.title: white as a sheet vs yellow belly
fine_lines.explanation_ar: white as a sheet: خائف الآن لأن شيئًا أخافه. yellow belly: جبان دائمًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: White as a sheet: scared now because something frightened you. Yellow belly: always a coward.

examples.sentence: She went white as a sheet after the accident.
He never helps in a fight; he's a yellow belly.

expressions.example: Will turned as white as a sheet when he heard the gunshot.
I'm tickled pink to meet you.
My friends were green with envy when they saw my new phone.
You look a little blue. What's wrong?

expressions.meaning_en: tired from talking with no effect
expressions.example: Bobby talked until he was blue in the face, but she said no.
He was caught red-handed taking money from the till.

questions.question: "Will turned ___ as a sheet when he heard the gunshot."
questions.explanation_ar: white as a sheet = شاحب من الخوف.
questions.explanation_en: White as a sheet = pale with fear.

questions.question: "Greg was ___ with envy when he saw Josh's new car."
"Bobby talked until he was ___ in the face, but she didn't change her mind."
questions.explanation_ar: blue in the face = منهك من الكلام بلا نتيجة.
questions.explanation_en: Blue in the face = exhausted from talking.

questions.question: "Mr. E is still ___ at his job." (new, no experience)
The thief was caught ___ while taking the money.
questions.explanation_en: Caught red-handed = caught in the act.

questions.question: A person who is always too afraid to help is a ___.
"Red in the face" usually means:
questions.explanation_ar: red in the face = غاضب جدًا.
